description: Keeps the virtual alarm (Alarmo, alarm_control_panel.home) and the physical Paradox EVO192 (PAI) in step, both ways (2026-10-13, operator). Home = Stay, Night = Stay too (operator 2026-10-13: night is a house mode; the panel does not switch at 22:00/06:00 and keeps its entry delay), Away = Away. Stay therefore satisfies Night in both directions (ok_states). Commands go straight to PAI's control topic (PAI's entity sends arm_sleep, which an EVO does not have). If the panel does not arm, Alarmo is put back where the panel is and both adults are told WHY. Alarmo triggered (a leak) sends the panel an emergency panic; the panel going off triggers Alarmo. The physical panel is the truth after a restart. Queued, and every run re-reads live state, so its own echoes find nothing to do. Tests: tests/climate/cases.py (alarm sync). A disarm asked for while the panel is offline is honoured (review 2026-10-13 F2). Alarmo has no codes: if a disarm code is ever set in Alarmo, every alarm_disarm here needs it (review F10), or Alarmo will stay armed over a disarmed panel.
